_comment: Default-FAIL contract for the autonomous long-running loop (pattern: anthropics/cwc-long-running-agents). EVERY criterion starts false and may only be flipped by a FRESH-CONTEXT evaluator that has no Write/Edit tools and did not see the build. The agent that did the work never grades it — this session produced 27 confirmed holes in work that passed its own author's tests, so self-grading is the failure mode this file exists to prevent. `evidence` must name a command whose real output a reader can re-run.
goal: Close the open verification work, then map and build the product surface the design thread says is missing — without any criterion passing on self-assessment.

rules.absenceIsNotRun: A criterion with no evidence is not-run, never passed. not-run and passed must never render the same.

criteria.statement: The causal-primacy knockout runner (parity #79) is merged to main and its tests pass on main.
criteria.verifyBy: gh pr view 79 --json state; npx vitest run scripts/tests/knockout-primacy.test.mjs scripts/tests/knockout-surgery.test.mjs

criteria.statement: Every concept the design thread proposes (StorySpec extension, DeckDirection, ExperienceSpec, Room-Ready, the tab set) is mapped to a real symbol in the codebase or explicitly recorded as absent — no proposal reported without checking whether it exists.
criteria.verifyBy: read docs/design/thread-concept-map.md and spot-check 3 claims with grep

criteria.statement: A council hop across BOTH design threads has run, and the contradiction between turn-17 Deck Direction and turn-19 Room-Ready (who owns deck-level decisions) is resolved with a recorded verdict.
criteria.verifyBy: graph-hop ledger node updated with both threads and the resolution

criteria.statement: Room-Ready ships as an EXTENSION of the existing NodeSlideStorySpec (decision sentence, room map, objection, one-slide, rehearsal), not a second schema owner, with scenario tests including the honest-work positive.
criteria.verifyBy: grep for a second canonical owner must find none; run the new test file

criteria.statement: The capture gate no longer treats a producer-supplied trace as an independent oracle: it either runs the browser itself or requires attested provenance, and a forged trace is refused.
criteria.verifyBy: replay the forged-trace exploit; it must exit non-zero

criteria.statement: Both repos: full test suite and lint are green (excluding the known pre-existing GitHub Actions policy failure and untracked WIP), and the real Atlas deck still gates clean.
criteria.verifyBy: npx vitest run; npx biome check .; atlas topology + distinctness gates
